reason: The report uses a raw bivariate OLS of 2023 productivity on training hours. It omits the pre-treatment confounders in the data (productivity_2020, firm size and age, R&D, export share, credit score and others), so the estimate is very likely confounded and can't be read as a causal effect. It also trims on the outcome, which is questionable. I could not re-run the analysis because shell execution was denied; this verdict rests on reading analysis.py and the codebook.
